async def act(page):
    # Get the current value of the 'Page Title *' textbox
    current_title = await page.get_by_role("group").get_by_role("textbox", name="Page Title *").input_value()
    # Check if the current title is already 'Cookie monster coming to your place'
    if current_title != "Cookie monster coming to your place":
        # Fill the textbox with the new title
        await page.get_by_role("group").get_by_role("textbox", name="Page Title *").fill("Cookie monster coming to your place")
    # Click the 'Save' button to save the changes
    await page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    # Wait for navigation or page load to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
